comments.00277328: HUD element script interpreter: runs a COverlay's m_pScript (opcodes in docs/HUD.md). Called for the player's ammo, health, lives, tokens and kill-count overlays.
comments.0027AD00: Starts a script on a HUD element: m_pScript = script, m_Mode = 2 (run), then runs the interpreter (func_00277328).
comments.00277CF0: Draws a number digit by digit (thousands, hundreds, tens, units) through func_0027A7A0: the HUD counters (ammo, health, lives). Real name unknown.
comments.0024C648: Draws the player HUD every frame: steps every overlay script, restarts ammo/lives/tokens/kill counters when their value changes (scripts in docs/HUD.md), draws icons (func_0027B320) and numbers (func_00277CF0). Health has no script: always drawn at its position, value (m_Health+0xFF)>>8.
comments.0027C1E8: Finds the player whose m_pCamera is this camera (player list from D_80119890 by m_pNext), then fills the viewport with the fog colour and the screen flash.
comments.0027B320: Draws a HUD sprite: (id, frame, x, y, scaleX, scaleY, ?). 300 = box behind ammo/health, 0x1F7 = health icon.
